R1C-camp-camp-0003.recDirections: Heading north on Hwy 19, drive past the turnoff to Port McNeill until you come to the junction of the West Main. Turn left onto the mainline - the Clint Beek Recreation Site is roughly 14 km from the highway (on gravel road). At 3.4 km, veer left onto the Keogh Main; then left onto the Cluxewe Main at 7.5 km. At the 10.5 km mark there'll be another obvious junction - turn right. Keep following the road, bearing right at the next two junctions, and soon you'll come to Keogh Lake and the site. DRIVE CAUTIOUSLY AND EXPECT TO MEET LOGGING TRAFFIC.
